response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '') AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT cc.state, AVG(cc.player_count) AS avg_player_count, AVG(cc.player_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.avg_count, 0)) AS avg_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(cc.player_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.total_count, 0)) AS avg_share_of_total FROM college_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY cc.state;

assumptions.assumption: Each college_id in college identifies one college with one state; the schema does not enforce this.
